decision.what: w_free REPLACES w_aro as the width-book yardstick for new work: new arms are reported beside / judged against w_free (plan_w_free, NNNC_W_FREE).
decision.scope: the yardstick only. Closed studies keep their pre-registered w_aro comparisons and verdicts (their judges are not edited). The sizer books (cs_aro, cs_aro_tr) still size w_aro's entries; moving them onto w_free's book is a separate change, not made here.
